verdict.rationale: Mailgun documents a quickstart promising a first send in under two minutes on a sandbox domain, and offers multi-language SDKs plus a Postman workspace with ready-to-use requests. Developers independently describe it as incredibly easy to integrate and needing less setup than competitors. However, the evidence never shows per-language copy-paste snippets or whether sandbox limits and the later custom-domain/DKIM requirements are surfaced up front, and one user reported opaque DNS validation errors. Missing for 10: evidence of copy-paste-complete quickstart code per language, explicit disclosure of sandbox restrictions and domain-verification steps, hands-on corroboration of the minutes-to-first-email claim.
